text:
maria: heads-up, nightly deploy triggered the autoscale warmup but we still saw a p99 spike for short requests, digging in :mag:
ben: which path? small prompt -> short completion or chat? saw something similar earlier today
maria: short prompt path, mostly 16-32 tokens completions. p50 fine, but p99 jumps from 90ms -> 400ms during scale-up window
carla: I pulled profiler traces. Kernel selection flipped to generic_matmul on some GPUs during the first few batches. suspect kernel cache miss + cold KV cache
maria: here's a snippet from the deploy warmup logs:
```
[2026-02-18T03:12:41Z] deploy-warmtail: sending synthetic prefill jobs -> 50 qps
[2026-02-18T03:12:44Z] kernel: selected=generic_matmul (fallback) reason=missing_kernel_cache
[2026-02-18T03:12:45Z] kv_cache: hit_rate=4% keys_prefetched=120
p99=385ms
```
dee: oof. our warmers only prefill prefix keys at per-deployer granularity; if topologies differ kernel compilation/cache warm -> fallback
ben: are warmers running as part of deploy or as a scheduled job afterwards? difference matters for autoscaler handoff
maria: deploy-time warmtail runs during rollout on new pool nodes. autoscaler also spawns nodes after commit sometimes; two different warm paths
leo: I think the regression comes from two orthogonal cold states: (1) compiled kernel/per-gpu kernel cache and (2) KV prefix cache. Warmtail only prefills KV, not kernel caches, so first inference pays JIT/compilation penalty
carla: confirmed with traces: timeline shows kernel_init at t+2s and then a batch with CPU fallback. Also saw kv-prefetch jobs hitting a higher entropy of keys than live traffic -> hit_rate low
maria: suggestion: make warmtail trigger a lightweight kernel touch by running a tiny micro-batch with representative shapes. like a single batched request per model variant
ops: that will add cost, but acceptable if it prevents p99 penalties. we should gate by node age and rollout stage
dee: another option: persistent kernel cache artifact. upload compiled kernels at image build and populate on boot. but cross-gpu issues may complicate
ben: can we change warmtail to use sticky affinity + gradual ramp to avoid full concurrency during autoscale? i.e., attach traffic to warmed nodes first
carla: also need to fix KV keying: warmers currently use full-prompt hashes which have too much entropy (user ids, session tokens). switch to canonicalized prefix hashing (strip creds, normalize whitespace) -> hit rate up
maria: ben, can you sketch a plan? prioritize minimal changes first
ben: plan proposal:
- short-term (hotfix, 24h): warmtail run extra "kernel-touch" micro-batch per model variant + canonicalize prefix hashing
- mid-term (2w): implement node-start kernel artifact restore + affinity-based rollout
- long-term (quarter): autoscaler hooks to run warmtail prior to marking node ready for serving
leo: also add perf regression alert: when p99 increases >2x during scale events, create an immediate pager. currently only error-rate pagers exist
ops: adding alert. will tune thresholds and add runbook link
carla: I'll add a quick perf dashboard card showing kv_hit_rate, kernel_fallback_count, kernel_init_duration correlated with p99 so we can triage faster
maria: awesome. I'll open a PR with the warmtail kernel-touch patch and the prefix canonicalization heuristic. tagging @infra-bot to run a staging deploy
infra-bot: CI pipeline started for refs/heads/warmtail/kernel-touch (build 9821) :building_man:
ben: thanks team. after hotfix deploy let's run two controlled autoscale scenarios and collect spans
maria: agreed — test windows: 03:00 and 09:00 UTC tomorrow. bench script will produce sample traces and kv hit heatmap
leo: leaving a note: when we run synthetic traffic, ensure sample distribution matches live token-length distribution. synthetic-only short tokens skew kernel selection false positives
maria: noted. will include length distribution matching in the script
carla: dropping a short checklist in the PR with telemetry query snippets and expected thresholds
maria: perfect. closing thread, will post results tomorrow :raised_hands:
